baseline.description: The product as the relay binary under test builds it: nothing changed.

classic.description: A local thread as Threads first shipped it, whatever the binary's default: Claude Code's prompt with Relay's after it, every agent op (Arbiter's too), JSON results.

lean.description: Relay's own short prompt in place of Claude Code's (--system-prompt), and only Tally's and Avex's tools.

readings.description: JSON results replaced by plain readings (relay-core readings.rs), nothing else changed.

lean-readings.description: lean, and reads answered as plain readings.

lean-readings-prefetch.description: lean and readings, and Tally's and Avex's summaries as readings ahead of the first message.

lean-readings-docs.description: lean and readings, and tools described in plain words with an example call each.

lean-readings-prefetch-docs.description: lean, readings, prefetch and docs: every part of the small-model profile.

think.description: The default small-model profile, with the model thinking before it answers, no limit.

think-512.description: The default small-model profile, with the model thinking before it answers, within 512 tokens.
